description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
